nativeRoute: Feishu Project Plugin Token + authorized X-USER-KEY OR official Project OAuth MCP

loginFlow.steps: 复用 FEISHU_PLUGIN_ID/SECRET/USER_KEY 且代理用户已授权 → owner Python/local MCP；不完整则仅使用已授权官方 Project OAuth MCP authenticate。普通 lark-cli 与业务 feishu-auth 都不能替代 Project 身份。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: Plugin token 客户端内存缓存 2h，X-USER-KEY 是实际用户；Plugin 权限 ∩ 安装空间 ∩ 用户权限；local MCP 固定 FEISHU_PROJECT_KEY。
subjectPermission: Plugin 先核对授权 user key 并读取目标空间/字段；OAuth MCP current_login_user；不同路径 identity 不能互换。
expiryRevoke: 预过期刷新；401 不自动重试，调用方重建 client/受控刷新一次；插件凭据由开放平台管理，OAuth 撤销走官方授权管理。

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.scope: Read-only documentation/repository discovery; no login, token issuance, credential inspection or business API execution.
